content.text:
I changed `runDaemonForContext` in `packages/playwright/src/mcp/test/browserBackend.ts` so the debug integration binds each browser once instead of once per context. I did not run a Playwright test against it. The TypeScript check reported no errors in that file.

**The cause:** `runAfterCreateBrowserContext` in `packages/playwright/src/index.ts` calls `runDaemonForContext` for every new context. That function called `browser.bind(...)` every time. `BrowserServer.start` throws "Server is already started" on the second call, which is the error from the issue.

**The fix:** a `WeakMap<Browser, string>` stores the session name for each browser. The first context on a browser binds it and records the name. Later contexts on that browser reuse the name. Each test still pauses at its start and prints the attach instructions, using the same session name for that browser.

**Choice I made:** a session name is now shared across all tests that run on the same worker browser, not generated per test. The issue asks that each test can be attached to with the same name, so I read that as sharing it. If you want a fresh session name per test, the bind would need to move into a per-test path instead.

I did not add a regression test for several tests in one worker, so the "several tests in one worker" case in the issue is unverified.
